verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's docs say it compiles, runs your test suite and sanitizers, and presents a diff for review before making permanent changes. Approval gating via `--ask-for-approval` and a headless `exec` mode for CI pipelines support pre-merge checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff-review and check workflow, detail on the diff inspection UX, and any explicit PR/merge-gate integration.
